sourceNotes: Experimental 1920x1080 profile. fx=fy are inferred from Lensfun's 6.7 mm nominal focal length and DJI's 1.197 um sensor-pixel specification, preserving the 8064-pixel sensor width through a centered 16:9 crop and scale to 1920 pixels. DJI lists FOV 82.1 degrees but does not label its direction; it is not used as a horizontal-FOV assumption. The derived diagonal FOV is only a consistency check. cx/cy assume an unshifted central crop. A physical checkerboard calibration remains required for production.
distortionNotes: Lensfun lists FC3582 PTLens a=-0.0075, b=0.026, c=-0.0027 at 6.7 mm. PTLens coefficients are not OpenCV Brown-Conrady coefficients and are intentionally not converted or copied here.
